evidence.text: In this fictional rule set, at least 5 transactions in one hour requires review. At least 15 requires escalation. At least 5 transactions combined with an account younger than 7 days also requires escalation. A signal is a reason for investigation, never proof of fraud.

Reject missing, extra, nonfinite and out-of-range input fields. Keep test data synthetic. The demonstration model has not been validated for live operations. Changing data, model code or policy content invalidates the local response cache and requires a new evaluation.

Escalations belong to the authorized payment-risk team. Analysts review legitimate customer explanations and existing case context. This tool does not block accounts, decline payments or contact customers. Real deployment requires outcome validation, drift monitoring and subgroup error analysis.
